source.paper: Abbott et al. 2017 (LIGO, Virgo, Fermi GBM, INTEGRAL), ApJ 848, L13: Gravitational Waves and Gamma-rays from a Binary Neutron Star Merger: GW170817 and GRB 170817A
source.terms: arXiv non-exclusive distribution licence (abs page read 2026-11-06); numbers and citation only

delay.definition: the paper writes the GRB170817A-minus-GW170817 time lag as (+1.74 +/- 0.05) s ('between GRB170817A and GW170817'); the GW signal arrives first; the paper's own definition is of the GBM trigger T0GBM against the GW time T0GW (a gamma-ray emission onset 0.310 +/- 0.048 s before T0GBM is also printed)

distance.which: lower bound of the 90% credible interval on the GW luminosity distance, used conservatively for the speed bound; the paper prints a combined range (42.9 +/- 3.2) Mpc from the host and Hubble-constant measures and 40 (+8, -14) Mpc from GW data alone

emissionDelay.locator: Section 4.1: the upper bound assumes the peak of the GW signal and the first photons were emitted simultaneously (zero offset); the lower bound assumes the SGRB signal was emitted 10 s after the GW signal
